item.title: Cornell faculty to begin voting on no-confidence resolution over handling of fraternity gang rape
item.description: Cornell University faculty will begin voting Wednesday on a proposed no-confidence resolution in the university’s administration amid frustration over its handling of a woman’s report that she was gang raped at a fraternity house in 2024.

item.title: Trump's cure for Republicans' midterm woes is more Trump. Will it work?
item.description: President Donald Trump wants midterm voters to imagine he's on the ballot and has seized the political spotlight in a way that makes such make-believe seem a bit more real.

item.title: 'Dixie' map that divided US into North and South is going up for auction
item.description: It’s perhaps the most consequential map in American history, and it could be yours. The hand-drawn chart of the Mason-Dixon Line that eventually divided the free and slave states is up for auction.

item.title: Federal Reserve likely to skip rate hike despite elevated inflation
item.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to stand pat on interest rates Wednesday even though inflation has accelerated in the past couple of months as the Iran war has caused spikes in oil and gas prices.
